spans.quote: Effective March 1, 2026, outside counsel must obtain written approval from the Quillfether Legal Operations team before using any generative AI tool on a new matter.
Our confidential information must not be used to train or improve any model, and prompts containing it must be deleted within 14 days.
Tools hosted outside the United States or Canada are not acceptable.
Counsel must disclose on each invoice which tasks were performed with AI assistance.
Human review of AI output is required in every case.
Quillfether encourages outside counsel to use AI tools where they reduce cost without reducing quality.
